race.description: Bishop Collins Audit Super Mdn Hcp
race.comment: WRITTEN DOLL (1) will be hitting his straps fourth up after three good efforts to open the campaign. He draws to get all the favours with Clark taking over and should be in this for a very long way. DRAGON BLOOD (4) trialled sharply ahead of his debut at Hawkesbury where he took a good account of himself. He's sure to have come on from that and is worth following up. TOO EXPENSIVE (8) is a Frankel gelding on debut for Kris Lees. Showed positive signs in his most recent trial and gets the blinkers on race day. Bullock's booking only helps his chances too. STAR HALF (3) resumes and will be hoping for a genuine tempo so he can be running on late under Schiller.
